about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a self-taught full stack developer, passionate about technology and problem-solving. After the COVID-19 pandemic, I decided to reinvent myself as a software engineer after spending more than 14 years leading customer service teams at a major telecommunications company, where I also studied Business Administration.
about.p2: As a developer, I worked at an agency on a project built with React, Node.js, AWS and TypeScript. I currently work as a Full Stack Developer at Multibreves, a technology company specialized in the automotive sector, where I develop and maintain platforms and marketplaces for spare parts management across different European markets using Next.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, Node.js, AWS and MongoDB.
about.p3: In 2024 I emigrated from Argentina to Spain, looking for new professional and personal challenges. I'm passionate about football, video games, anime, and travelling. I consider myself a great team player with a strong sense of commitment and a continuous learner.
